name: io.github.pcDamasceno/cisco-sdwan-mcp
title: Cisco SD-WAN MCP Server
description: MCP server for Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN (vManage): fabric inventory, device health, alarms, policies.

environmentVariables.name: SDWAN_VMANAGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager URL, e.g. https://vmanage.example.com:8443

environmentVariables.name: SDWAN_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: vManage username. Use a dedicated read-only account.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Must be stdio for this install. The server itself defaults to http; set http only when deploying it as a service.

environmentVariables.name: SDWAN_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify the vManage TLS certificate. Prefer SDWAN_CA_BUNDLE over disabling this.

environmentVariables.name: SDWAN_CA_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a CA bundle for a private-CA or self-signed vManage certificate.

environmentVariables.name: SDWAN_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the configuration-changing tools. Read-only when unset.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.installationNote: Read-only by default. See https://github.com/pcDamasceno/cisco-sdwan-mcp#connecting-an-mcp-client for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor setup.
